Name: Pierre Sells Fiber Seeds
Author: MsSadisticNight049
Description:
[size=4]It's as the title says, Pierre now sells Fiber Seeds, because I got tired of contantly running out and having to wait forever to get fiber to make grass starters and other crafting recipes.[/size]

[size=4]Only requirements for the mod is SMAPI and Content Patcher. [/size]

[size=4]To install the mod, just unzip the downloaded file and drop its contents into youe 'Mods' folder.[/size]

[size=4](Important Note: Ignore that it says 100g on the picture, that was a screenshot taken before I edited the file, when you load the mod, they should be 50g)[/size]

Manifest.Name: Pierre Sells Fiber Seeds
Manifest.Description: Adds Fiber Seeds to Pierre's shop for 50g.
Manifest.Author: MsSadisticNight
